title: 第1章 魔刀现 庸才殇第2章 接受条件
lines: 残阳如血，落日山脉群峰连绵数十万里，参差不齐，宛如万千刀剑直刺苍穹！将过往的白云切割成千丝万缕。
“少爷”
“少爷，你快醒醒”
在一阵阵急切的吵闹声中，一个面如骷髅，骨瘦如柴的少年缓缓醒来！......
萧家后山的一座山峰上，一位身着青色长衫，看起来只有十六七岁的少年正坐在床前发呆，打量着自己脑海里的一把血色小刀，深深的叹了口气。
想起十五日前发生的事情，少年至今感觉不可思议！
少年名叫萧羽，从小在青山镇长大，萧家在镇算是一个大家族，不过在武风盛行的天武大陆，萧家也只能算是一个很小很小的武道世家。
而萧羽在三岁那年的武道天赋检测中只出现了一道灵纹，可以说是一个地地道道的修炼废柴，但是因为萧家老祖也就是萧羽的爷爷对这个孙子疼爱有加，
所以萧家上下对萧羽还是以少爷的身份对待，但是因为萧羽的修炼天赋实在是太差了，在萧羽的身上浪费了太多的天材地宝，萧家上下已经是颇有微词，只不过碍于老祖的威势不敢造次而已。
而这次在落日山脉边缘的家族试炼中，萧羽因为一头一级魔兽风狼的追赶，不慎跌入一个山洞中，醒来之后，血肉枯竭，如同一个骨头架子一般，
而且诡异的是，他明明是在山洞中晕倒，醒来是却已在落日山脉边缘的草丛里，而那个山洞却不见了，脑海中多了那把血红色的小刀！
然而最让萧羽不能接受的是，本来仅存的天赋：一品灵纹竟然在缓缓消失，在这十五天里，连那唯一的一品灵纹也是消失不见了。
他成了一个真正的废物！
虽然爷爷请了镇上最好的二品丹师，也看不出个所以然来，最后摇头而去！
最后连萧家老祖，也不得不接受了这样的结果，萧羽完全成为了一个凡人！
甚至连普通凡人的体质他都有所不及，因为气血的大量消失，现在导致他连走路都会感觉疲累。
在消耗了家族里作为至宝的唯一的四品丹药都不见任何好转！
这让萧家的其他人更是对萧羽怨气冲天！
只有萧羽自己清楚是怎么回事，因为四品丹药刚刚吞入还没等他炼化，便化作一缕灵气，被脑海中的那把小刀给吸走了！
是的，没错就是被那把该死的血色小刀给吸走了，而且他唯一的灵纹也是被把小刀给吞了！
而且他可以确定的是，在吞完他的灵药和灵纹之后这把小刀还在他的识海了慵懒的翻了个身！
“一定是你当日吸走了我的气血对不对？你还抢走了我的灵纹和灵药！你这个混蛋，滚出我的身体。”
萧羽在心中大骂，他相信这把诡异的小刀一定能够听到，也能听懂，但是就是没有任何回应。
这让萧羽抓狂中又有些无奈！
又是半月过去，萧家族人对他的态度变得更加冷漠了，这半个月来萧羽经历了族人数不尽的白眼和讽刺。
甚至连照顾他起居的小侍女，都对他这个主子爱搭不理！
萧羽的一切起居和饮食基本都是靠自己！
而他从本来从一品灵纹的庸才变成了灵纹彻底消失的废物的消息，也是在青山镇中不胫而走，他也成了青山镇中家喻户晓的存在！
讥讽，嘲笑，幸灾乐祸各种声音和面孔几乎要将他给淹没。
山风轻拂，朝阳初升，萧羽吸了口气，准备开始修炼，虽然他连一品灵纹都没有了，但是性格坚韧的他并不准备放弃。
迎着朝阳，萧羽一遍又一遍的运转着萧家特有的武诀《搬山经》，希望可以重新感觉到灵气，重新修炼，他不想一辈子成为别人眼中的废物！
尤其是想起当日爷爷那失望而又无奈的眼神，成为他心中永远的痛！......
可是近七日的修炼，不仅没有让他感受到一点点的灵气，反而让他的经脉，犹如火焰炙烤般的灼痛，头上豆大汗珠滚滚而落，经脉的痛楚，几乎让他昏厥！
他心中不甘的嘶吼“为什么？！为什么？”
在喃喃声中，萧羽的意识终于昏迷，皎洁的月光洒下，没有人注意到，萧羽的眉心处，缓缓飘出了一道黑影。
看着昏迷的萧羽，黑影轻轻的道
“作为他的儿子，你又岂能是凡人，可是还不够！”

content_en:
The setting sun is like blood, and the peaks of the Sunset Mountain Range stretch for hundreds of thousands of miles and are uneven, like thousands of swords piercing the sky! Cut the passing white clouds into thousands of strands.
"Master"
"Master, wake up quickly"
Amidst the bursts of urgent noises, a skinny boy with a face like a skeleton slowly woke up! ...
On a mountain peak behind the Xiao family, a young man wearing a green gown and looking to be only sixteen or seventeen years old was sitting in front of the bed in a daze, looking at a bloody knife in his mind, and sighed deeply.
Thinking of what happened fifteen days ago, the young man still feels incredible!
The boy's name is Xiao Yu. He grew up in Qingshan Town. The Xiao family is considered a big family in the town, but in the Tianwu Continent where martial arts is prevalent, the Xiao family can only be regarded as a very small martial arts family.
When Xiao Yu was three years old, only one spiritual pattern appeared in the martial arts talent test. He could be said to be an out-and-out useless practitioner. However, because the ancestor of the Xiao family, Xiao Yu's grandfather, loved his grandson very much,
Therefore, the Xiao family still treats Xiao Yu as a young master. However, because Xiao Yu's cultivation talent is really poor and too many natural and earthly treasures were wasted on Xiao Yu, the Xiao family has already complained about it, but they dare not make mistakes due to the power of the ancestor.
And this time during the family trial on the edge of the Sunset Mountains, Xiao Yu accidentally fell into a cave because of the pursuit of a first-level magical beast, the Wind Wolf. When he woke up, his flesh and blood were as dry as a skeleton.
And the strange thing is that he obviously fainted in the cave, but when he woke up, he was already in the grass on the edge of the Sunset Mountains. The cave was gone, and the blood-red knife was in his mind!
However, what Xiao Yu couldn't accept the most was that the only remaining talent: the first-grade spiritual pattern was slowly disappearing. In these fifteen days, even the only first-grade spiritual pattern disappeared.
He has become a real loser!
Even though grandpa invited the best second-grade alchemist in the town, he couldn't see why, and finally shook his head and left!
In the end, even the ancestor of the Xiao family had to accept this result, and Xiao Yu completely became a mortal!
Even his physique is inferior to that of an ordinary mortal. Because of the massive loss of Qi and blood, he now feels tired even when walking.
Even after consuming the only fourth-grade elixir that is the most precious treasure in the family, there is no improvement!
This made other people in the Xiao family even more resentful towards Xiao Yu!
Only Xiao Yu himself knew what was going on, because the fourth-grade elixir had just been swallowed and before he could refine it, it turned into a wisp of spiritual energy and was sucked away by the knife in his mind!
Yes, that's right, he was sucked away by that damn bloody knife, and his only spiritual mark was also swallowed by the knife!
And what he can be sure of is that after swallowing his elixir and spiritual patterns, the knife was still in his sea of ​​​​consciousness and he turned over lazily!
"You must have sucked my blood that day, right? You also stole my spiritual patterns and elixir! You bastard, get out of my body."
Xiao Yu cursed in his heart. He believed that this weird knife could hear and understand it, but there was no response.
This made Xiao Yu crazy and helpless!
Another half month passed, and the attitude of the Xiao family members towards him became even more indifferent. In the past half month, Xiao Yu had experienced countless glares and sarcasm from his family members.
Even the little maid who took care of his daily life ignored him as his master!
Xiao Yu basically relies on himself for all his daily life and food!
And the news that he had transformed from a mediocre person with a first-grade spirit pattern to a waste whose spirit patterns had completely disappeared spread like wildfire in Qingshan Town, and he became a household name in Qingshan Town!
The voices and faces of sarcasm, ridicule, and schadenfreude almost overwhelmed him.
The mountain breeze was blowing gently and the sun was rising. Xiao Yu took a breath and prepared to start practicing. Although he didn't even have a first-grade spiritual pattern, he was not ready to give up due to his tenacious character.
Facing the rising sun, Xiao Yu ran the Xiao family's unique martial art "Moving Mountain Sutra" over and over again, hoping to feel the spiritual energy again and practice again. He didn't want to be a waste in the eyes of others for the rest of his life!
Especially when he thought of his grandfather's disappointed and helpless look that day, it became an eternal pain in his heart! ...
However, the past seven days of practice not only did not allow him to feel any spiritual energy, but instead caused his meridians to burn like a flame. Beads of sweat rolled down his head. The pain in his meridians almost made him faint!
He screamed unwillingly in his heart, "Why?! Why?"
Amidst the muttering, Xiao Yu's consciousness finally fell into unconsciousness. Under the bright moonlight, no one noticed that a dark shadow slowly floated out between Xiao Yu's eyebrows.
Looking at Xiao Yu who was unconscious, the black shadow said softly
"As his son, how can you be a mortal, but that's not enough!"
